title: Kya Banana Radioactive Hai? 🍌 #shorts
idea: Bananas are naturally radioactive because they contain high amounts of potassium.

lines.text: Kya aapko pata hai ki har banana andar se radioactive hota hai?
Iska sach yeh hai ki isme potassium ka amount bohot high hota hai.
World mein 2022 mein total world production of bananas and plantains combined 179 million tonnes thi.
Isme India aur China ka contribution sabse bada hai jo approximately 26% hai.
Matlab aap jab bhi ek banana khate ho, aap thodi si natural radiation bhi consume karte ho.
Kya aap abhi bhi roz banana khana chahoge ya darr lag gaya? Comments mein batao!
